trigger_window.precondition: A KvStoreResultSet is obtained by getResultSet and remains reachable from JS.
sequence: Call closeResultSet(resultSet); its NAPI execute is scheduled through NapiQueue::AsyncWork.
On the async worker, CloseResultSet execute reads GetInstance(), writes SetInstance(nullptr), then calls kvStore->CloseResultSet(local resultSet copy).
Before or during that worker write, the JS thread invokes synchronous getEntry, which calls GetInstance() and copies the same instance_.

The modeled race is the unsynchronized shared_ptr owner copy in getEntry versus SetInstance(nullptr) in close execute; underlying KvStoreResultSet::GetEntry versus CloseResultSet is a separate pointee protocol obligation.

minimum_interface_and_evidence_requireme: Provide a reproducible OpenHarmony product/component build command, full dependency/toolchain manifest, built library/device image identity and exact install/package paths.
Provide an instrumented NAPI fixture or product run that records JS thread, async execute thread, complete callback queue and the exact closeResultSet/getEntry overlap window.
Provide runtime permission/policy trace for getResultSet/getEntry/closeResultSet: permission name, app identity, user/sandbox boundary, grant mode and failure result.
Provide product-level crash/sanitizer/memory evidence that distinguishes shared_ptr owner UB from result-set use-after-close and establishes stable exploitability.
Provide CIA evidence with measured availability failure, integrity effect on returned entries and confidentiality boundary across app/device domains.
Provide attacker-control and deployment reachability: caller identity, privilege, input constraints, trigger rate, product module and affected image/version/branch evidence.
Apply the proposed fix to the real component and repeat vulnerable/fixed/patched under identical product build/profile; keep this package candidate until independent review signs the gate.
limitations: The Harness is self-contained and models the source-visible call shape; it does not execute OpenHarmony, the KV store backend or a live product service.
TSan proves a data race in the exact JSProxy owner pair; it does not prove UAF, memory corruption, data disclosure, privilege escalation or stable exploitability.
The product entry is source-visible but deployment resolution and runtime policy are partial/unknown.
No historical report, candidate ID, review or source object was rewritten; this supplement is additive.
